_doc: Canonical tool-name list per spec/002-Tool-Registry.md. Shared by the Node stdio roundtrip (stdio-roundtrip.js) and the cross-server conformance harness (tools/mcp-conformance) so the expected `tools/list` response cannot drift between hand-maintained lists. Sorted alphabetically; both consumers compare against the sorted form. The two browser-only reads, list-substrates and read-a11y-violations, are absent: they are listed only on a host whose provider is reachable, which the JVM stdio host never is (spec/002-Tool-Registry.md).
